newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $582 mln for Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $582 mln for Tuesday.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for Tuesday are expected to total $582 million in 30 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $207 million in six sales, with a $85 million Jefferson County, Ky, deal through Smith Barney Inc., topping the list.
On the competitive side, 24 sales totaling $375 million are scheduled. A $141 million Mississippi deal at 1200 EDT is the largest.
An additional three sales totaling $105 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues Tuesday depending on market conditions.
